profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with no setup required. Its site also highlights a feature called Intelligent Model Routing, which it claims delivers the same quality output at 65% lower average cost than the previous version of its Max Mode offering.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as a coding and developer tool, focused on agentic coding. The held facts note a source-code exposure concern associated with the product. Replit also has a registered MCP server entry described as providing free buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for supplied agent receipts, listed under the name app.replit.austere-unsteady-pdf/free-agent-economy-lab. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
